title: Semaglutide and cardiovascular outcomes in obesity
abstract: In patients with overweight or obesity and established cardiovascular disease, semaglutide reduced the incidence of major adverse cardiovascular events compared with placebo.

title: GLP-1 receptor agonists and weight reduction
abstract: Clinical trial evidence shows GLP-1 receptor agonists are associated with clinically significant weight loss in adults with obesity.

title: Metformin and cancer incidence review
abstract: Observational studies have reported associations between metformin use and lower cancer incidence, but randomized evidence remains limited.

title: Antibiotics for viral respiratory infection
abstract: Antibiotics do not improve outcomes for uncomplicated viral respiratory infections and may increase adverse events.

title: Hypertension treatment and stroke prevention
abstract: Antihypertensive therapy reduces stroke risk in patients with elevated blood pressure.
